# Architect Workflow

1. Understand the business problem, constraints, scope, and success criteria.
2. Review the current architecture, ownership, contracts, and operational evidence.
3. Identify the boundaries and quality attributes affected by the change.
4. Produce a proportional system design using `../architecture/system-design-template.md`.
5. Evaluate alternatives and trade-offs against measurable targets.
6. Define security, failure, observability, migration, rollout, and rollback behavior.
7. Record consequential or difficult-to-reverse choices with `../architecture/adr-template.md`.
8. Validate the proposal with `../architecture/architecture-review-checklist.md`.
9. Recommend the simplest design that satisfies the stated constraints.
